prerequisites.title: Privacy policy and terms of service
prerequisites.detail: A blog says both should be linked in the developer dashboard.

prerequisites.title: Written scope justifications
prerequisites.detail: The blog says to explain clearly why each scope (such as posting) is needed.

prerequisites.title: Funded API usage
prerequisites.detail: X API pay-per-use charges per call, for example $0.015 per post created and $0.001 per owned resource read. New accounts can earn up to $70 in free credits.

steps.title: Create X developer app
steps.detail: Log in to the X developer console and create an app. The research did not find official steps, so follow the current docs.
steps.done_when: You have a client ID and client secret.

steps.title: Draft scope justifications
steps.detail: Draft a short explanation of why each scope is needed, and check the privacy policy and terms pages exist.
steps.done_when: Each scope has a written justification.

steps.title: Register exact callback URL
steps.detail: Copy the redirect URI from the Composio dashboard and add it exactly in the developer portal. Use HTTPS in production.
steps.done_when: The portal lists the exact callback URL.

steps.title: Create Composio auth config
steps.detail: Create a custom auth config through Composio's API with your client ID and secret. Request offline.access if you need refresh tokens.
steps.done_when: The auth config exists and a test connection succeeds.

steps.title: Wait for any X review
steps.detail: If X asks for a security review or Elevated access, wait for the result. No duration is documented.
steps.done_when: Write or DM scopes work for outside users.

traps.title: Access tokens die after about 2 hours
traps.detail: Without the offline.access scope no refresh token is issued, so the token simply expires.

traps.title: Callback URL must match exactly
traps.detail: Protocol, slashes and trailing slash must match, and localhost differs from 127.0.0.1.

traps.title: Rate limits and billing are separate
traps.detail: You can incur usage costs while within rate limits.

traps.title: Temporary daily read limits on accounts
traps.detail: One page reports temporary limits of 6000 posts/day for verified, 600 for unverified and 300 for new unverified accounts, later reported raised. These apply to accounts, not to apps awaiting review.

blockers.what_it_means: A blog says some scopes require Elevated access.
blockers.what_to_do: Apply for Elevated access or re-check the requested permissions.
blockers.agent_can_help: Compare requested scopes with what the agent needs and trim them.
